submission.reasoning: This is logon-script persistence (MITRE T1037.001) on workstation5. At 02:46:45Z an interactive cmd.exe (proc-23dc9b1636, PID 8836) wrote C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\art.bat. At 02:47:08Z the same cmd.exe launched reg.exe (proc-55d9f85e37, user WORKSTATION5\wardog, High integrity). reg.exe set HKCU\Environment\UserInitMprLogonScript to that batch file (reg-35300c4876), so it will run every time wardog logs on. The pattern (a batch file dropped in Temp, then registered as a logon script) matches the Atomic Red Team T1037.001 test, but persistence is in place regardless of intent. The graph shows no run of art.bat yet. Recommended response: delete the registry value and the batch file, and isolate the host while it is checked.
